button.title: Tell-ME Global Search (Ctrl+K or Alt+Q)
button.style: border: 1px solid var(--fix-color-border-default, #e0e0e0); border-radius: var(--fix-dimension-border-radius-sm, 4px); padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-xs, 4px) var(--fix-dimension-space-sm, 8px); background: var(--fix-color-surface-primary, #fff); color: var(--fix-color-text-secondary, #616161); font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-200, 12px); cursor: pointer;

div.style: position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: var(--fix-zindex-dialog, 200); display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; padding-top: 80px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);

width: 480px; max-width: 90vw; border-radius: var(--fix-dimension-border-radius-lg, 12px); box-shadow: var(--fix-shadow-xxl, 0 8px 32px rgba(4,33,30,0.22)); background: var(--fix-color-surface-primary, #fff); overflow: hidden;

input.placeholder: Search modules, screens, reports… (EN or বাংলা)
input.t-on-keydown: (ev) => { if (ev.key === 'Escape') state.isOpen = false; if (ev.key === 'ArrowDown') { ev.preventDefault(); state.activeIndex = Math.min(state.activeIndex + 1, state.results.length - 1); } if (ev.key === 'ArrowUp') { ev.preventDefault(); state.activeIndex = Math.max(state.activeIndex - 1, 0); } if (ev.key === 'Enter' && state.results.length > 0) { ev.preventDefault(); _open(state.results[state.activeIndex]); } }
input.style: border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fix-color-border-default, #e0e0e0); border-radius: 0; padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px); font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-300, 14px); width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none;

div.style: padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px); color: var(--fix-color-text-ink-faint, #bdbdbd); font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-200, 12px);

button.style: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--fix-dimension-space-sm, 8px); width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-xs, 4px) var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px); border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-200, 12px);

span.t-attf-style: background: var(--fix-color-status-info-bg, #ebf8f6); color: var(--fix-color-status-info, #0e7a6e); font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: var(--fix-dimension-border-radius-xs, 2px); text-transform: uppercase;

div.style: padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-xs, 4px) var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px); border-top: 1px solid var(--fix-color-border-default, #e0e0e0); color: var(--fix-color-text-ink-faint, #bdbdbd); font-size: 10px;
